scope: document only: axis names, inputs, outputs, clocks, label availability and replay semantics so later specs can be frozen one at a time; no cadence, threshold, operation, call, fit or online update is implied or authorized; Fly delta-rule updates are training under the same scope control as fits; existing saved B ledger/results are preserved, never rewritten

clocks_per_record.market_as_of: the last completed KR session D whose data the record uses (session date)
clocks_per_record.decision_at: the logical output timestamp AFTER data confirmation for D: not the close instant; in point_in_time mode it is the actual time the output was produced once every input had source_received_at <= decision_at; in replay mode it is the modeled confirmation time (close of D + declared confirmation lag; regular-session fallback D 15:31:00+09:00)
clocks_per_record.decision_not_before: the earliest admissible decision_at for D: the completion time of D's bar under the applicable completion rule
clocks_per_record.input_available_at: point_in_time mode: the maximum source_received_at over all inputs (must be <= decision_at); replay mode: the modeled availability of the latest input (close of D + confirmation lag), reported next to the actual file timestamps, never as observed availability
clocks_per_record.source_received_at: the actual time each input file or message was received/fetched (file fetched_at, API response time); always retained verbatim
clocks_per_record.produced_at: wall-clock UTC when the record was computed
clocks_per_record.vintage_mode: point_in_time (every input has source_received_at <= decision_at and provenance proves it) or retrospective_latest_vintage (history fetched later; the record states that availability is modeled, not observed)

completion_rules.regular_session: a KR daily bar for D is treated as complete at D 15:31:00+09:00; this is an explicit regular-session replay assumption, not exchange or provider proof
completion_rules.special_session: sessions with a different close (half days, special openings) use their own declared completion time from a known-at-time calendar; if no such calendar entry exists the record abstains
completion_rules.precedence: a known-at-time exchange calendar or provider finality flag, when present, overrides the fallback and is recorded as completion_source

label_availability_per_target.rule: each target declares label_start_at, label_end_at and two availability clocks: actual_label_available_at (point_in_time mode: source_received_at of the data that completes the label) and replay_label_available_at (replay mode: raw endpoint event time plus the target-specific declared lag, exactly once); a component may update with a label only after the availability clock of its mode; evaluation splits purge every record whose availability exceeds the split boundary; no shared maturity clock; no shorthand such as s <= D - 20 replaces the clock predicate unless endpoint completion at decision_at is established under the mode in force

B_teacher_20.availability: when the D+21 opening price is observable (actual: source_received_at of that open; replay: D+21 open + confirmation lag)
B_teacher_20.definition: z(D,0), z(D,1) as in the frozen B teacher

E_close20.availability: completion of the D+20 bar under the applicable completion rule (actual or replay)
E_close20.definition: event iff min over s in D+1..D+20 of C_s / C_D - 1 <= -0.05 on the same causal adjusted-close series as the B price features (latest-vintage limitation retained); the primary and only forward endpoint of the first research phase; a declared research endpoint, not a validated exit threshold

E_peak20_future_alternative.definition: event iff min over s in D+1..D+20 of (C_s / max over u in D..s of C_u - 1) <= -0.05 (largest drawdown magnitude inside the window >= 5%); corrected from v1 (closes 100,96,94,97: drawdowns -4%,-6%,-3%; v1 max gave -3% -> no event; correct min gives -6% -> event)
E_peak20_future_alternative.status: retained as a future alternative; not selected alongside E_close20 and never chosen after seeing results

S_generated_state_at_D.availability: n/a: training-only metadata of generated paths (hidden regime at D); never an inference input; never a real-market label

numeric_feature_vector_V_D.price_basis: the same causal adjusted-close series as the B price features; latest-vintage limitation retained and stated in every record
numeric_feature_vector_V_D.frozen_5: logret5, logret20, logret60, ma200_distance, sd20 exactly as timing_lgbm_v1.features (sd20 = population std of the 20 log returns t = D-19..D)

added_5.log_slope20: sum over j = 0..19 of ((j - 9.5) * ln(C_(D-19+j))) / 665; units: log price per asset session (ordinary least squares slope over the last 20 closes)
added_5.down_count10: sum over t = D-9..D of 1[C_t < C_(t-1)]; ties are not down
added_5.vol_ratio: population std of the 60 log returns (t = D-59..D) divided by the population std of the 20 log returns (t = D-19..D)

numeric_feature_vector_V_D.eligibility_and_abstain: a session is eligible only if every feature is defined (enough history, finite values, sd20 > 0 so that vol_ratio has a non-zero denominator); otherwise all compared numeric axes abstain together with reason 'undefined feature'; no fabricated or default values; the same eligibility mask applies to T, F1 and the logistic baseline
numeric_feature_vector_V_D.order: the feature order is frozen and included in the encoder identity: [logret5, logret20, logret60, ma200_distance, sd20, logret120, log_slope20, drawdown60, down_count10, vol_ratio]

fields: value_type (scalar_score | probability_vector | label | ranked_records | fraction | abstain)
calibration_status (uncalibrated | calibrated_on:<train/validation set, period, method, frozen_at> | n/a)
confidence_basis (sample count | agreement | past calibration | none)
provenance (input file paths and sha256, source_received_at, calendar/completion source, code sha256, model/encoder identity)
rules: scores and probabilities are never relabelled as each other
a component that cannot produce an output abstains explicitly with a reason
state outputs and forward-risk outputs are separate axis ids and never share a calibration claim

any calibration mapping is fitted only on predeclared training/validation labels that are available before its cutoff, then frozen and evaluated on test; no calibration fitting on test paths or test periods

B_direction.question: at decision_at of D, which cost-inclusive one-share action value is higher over the next 20 sessions (held 0: buy vs cash; held 1: keep vs sell)?
B_direction.inputs: the frozen 6 features at D (frozen_5 + held)
B_direction.model: frozen yearly B fits of result 0b10b9da, each applied only in its own execution year; saved results preserved

T_state.question: at decision_at of D, which generated-regime state does the current pattern resemble: down / up / neutral?
T_state.calibration_status: uncalibrated by default; if a calibration mapping is fitted it uses generated training/validation paths only, is frozen before test, and is reported as calibrated_on:generated train/validation; it is never described as a calibrated E_close20 probability
T_state.semantics: generated-state resemblance under the declared mapping down={descent,crash}, up={ascent,rebound}, neutral={sideways,highvol}; not a real-market trend truth

T_forward_risk.question: at decision_at of D, will E_close20 occur?
T_forward_risk.value_type: scalar_score, or probability only with a calibration mapping fitted on predeclared train/validation labels available before the cutoff
T_forward_risk.learner: to be fixed in its own spec; training uses only labels whose availability clock precedes each training cutoff; no real-label fitting before that spec

F1_fly_state.question: same as T_state
F1_fly_state.inputs: V_D -> encoder (see F2 encoder identity) -> top-k code z_D -> state readout head
F1_fly_state.comparability: same V_D, same eligibility mask and same target as T_state

F1_fly_forward_risk.question: same as T_forward_risk
F1_fly_forward_risk.calibration_status: uncalibrated unless a mapping is fitted on predeclared train/validation labels and frozen
F1_fly_forward_risk.learning: delta-rule updates only after the availability clock of E_close20 at the sample's D under the mode in force; every update is training and is logged with decision_at and label availability; the current avoid weights and the 7-panel-row horizon are not transplanted
F1_fly_forward_risk.controls: degree/weight-matched rewired Fly, frozen (no-learning) Fly, native-feature logistic baseline on V_D with the same target, eligibility and budget
F1_fly_forward_risk.paired_randomness: for each replicate id, connectome and rewired controls share the feature scaler, the actual feature-to-PN projection P, the training data and its order and the readout initialisation; topology randomisation uses a separate declared RNG stream; LightGBM and Fly share replicate ids only (identical seed integers are not equivalent randomness)
F1_fly_forward_risk.comparability: same V_D, same eligibility mask and same target as T_forward_risk

F2_fly_similar_cases.question: which earlier sessions had the most similar sparse code to D, and what happened after them?
F2_fly_similar_cases.encoder_identity: version id = sha256 over: encoder code version, input feature schema and order (as frozen above), scaler arrays (train-prefix statistics), the actual projection matrix P, the actual PN->KC connectivity matrix used (with connectome file sha256), theta snapshot, top-k / sparsity value, activation and normalisation constants; a seed alone is not an identity; query and every candidate are encoded with the same version; a later encoder change creates a new version and a new code cache before any scoring; codes of different versions are never compared; no encoding work in this document phase
F2_fly_similar_cases.training_prefix: sessions <= 2014-12-30 (the first B cutoff) define the scaler and theta snapshot; the first scored decision is strictly after that prefix; all compared methods use the same explicit scored window
F2_fly_similar_cases.candidates: sessions s whose E_close20 label availability clock (actual or replay, per the mode in force) <= decision_at of D; no date shorthand replaces this predicate
F2_fly_similar_cases.selection: rank candidates by cosine similarity of codes; tie-break by deterministic session id order; greedily accept a candidate only if its anchor is >= 21 asset sessions from every accepted anchor (closed outcome windows [s, s+20] do not overlap); stop at k = 10; return fewer if insufficient
F2_fly_similar_cases.value_type: ranked_records of {session s, similarity, 20-session return C_(s+20)/C_s - 1, largest drawdown magnitude in (s, s+20], E_close20 label at s, label availability clock}
F2_fly_similar_cases.also_returned: candidate_count, returned_count, similarity spread, encoder version id, remaining dependence on the input window
F2_fly_similar_cases.calibration_status: n/a; k and similarity are not confidence
F2_fly_similar_cases.use: evidence shown to Jev stage 2 (later) and to the owner as dated examples; no decision change in phase 1

R_feasibility_rules.question: given a target weight and a next-open input, what integer quantity is affordable with costs, and which position rules fire?
R_feasibility_rules.inputs: account state with its own source_received_at, next-open input with observed_at, frozen rule parameters
R_feasibility_rules.value_type: ranked_records (computed quantity, fired rules with their inputs)
R_feasibility_rules.implementation: dobby_kr_core_v1 quantity() for sizing; rules as explicit predicates; the bill.py guard remains in the execution layer and judges book conditions only; outputs are computations, not orders

J_jev_blind_stage1.inputs: a dated daily chart image of sessions D-119..D rendered from completed bars only (close, MA20, MA200, volume) plus plain facts: last close, 5/20/60-session returns, drawdown from the 60-session peak; no outputs of other axes, no account state
J_jev_blind_stage1.chart_warmup: MA200 over a 120-session display needs up to 319 closes (D-318..D); the chart is drawn from adequate historical warm-up or the unavailable MA200 segment is visibly omitted; missing volume is marked as missing, never invented
J_jev_blind_stage1.question: 1) is the current trend down, up or unclear? 2) conditional preference for the next 20 sessions: long, cash or unclear (no position in this question) 3) the horizon you have in mind 4) one-line reason 5) stated confidence low/medium/high
J_jev_blind_stage1.calibration_status: uncalibrated; the stated confidence is not an outcome probability
J_jev_blind_stage1.optional_action_form: if action labels are wanted later, ask held=0 and held=1 as two separate questions
J_jev_blind_stage1.stage_2: deferred to a separately scoped comparison; no calls in this phase

aggregate.phase_1: none; each axis is recorded and scored separately against its own target with its own availability clock
aggregate.phase_2: one aggregate formula is predeclared and frozen before any test; only then are frozen ablations (B-only, leave-one-expert-out) run; the aggregate is never selected on test gains

evaluation_phase_1_axis_wise.scored_window: the same explicit window for every compared method: first scored decision strictly after 2014-12-30; target fitting requires labels available by each training cutoff
evaluation_phase_1_axis_wise.state_axes: T_state and F1_fly_state against S_generated_state on generated check/test paths only; confusion matrices; no real-market claim
evaluation_phase_1_axis_wise.forward_axes: T_forward_risk, F1_fly_forward_risk and the logistic baseline against E_close20 on eligible real sessions: precision/recall/false alarms at predeclared operating points, log-loss and Brier only where probabilities are claimed, detection delay and warning persistence; yearly blocks
evaluation_phase_1_axis_wise.retrieval_axis: F2: for each D, the outcome distribution of returned cases vs the realised E_close20 at D; coverage statistics; spacing audit
evaluation_phase_1_axis_wise.jev_axis: stage-1 labels vs realised E_close20 and vs the 20-session return sign; agreement with T/F1 recorded but not used
evaluation_phase_1_axis_wise.uncertainty: chronological block summaries; no independent-row intervals on overlapping windows
evaluation_phase_1_axis_wise.selection: no winner selection on test; seeds, replicate ids and operating points predeclared

explicitly_not_in_this_document: transplant of current Fly avoid weights
code, fits, online updates, encoding runs, Jev or API calls
accepted_by: bill; consolidated from dobby v3 with the explicit resolutions below
source_v3_open_questions: the declared confirmation lag for replay availability (drafted: 1 minute after the bar completion time, i.e. D 15:31:00+09:00 for regular sessions)
the known-at-time KR calendar source to be used for special sessions
the number of replicate ids per control pair (drafted 5)

final_resolutions.confirmation_lag: For the declared ordinary-session retrospective replay assumption only: scheduled close15:30 plus60seconds = modeled confirmation15:31KST. The60seconds is applied once to the raw market event end, not added again to an already-finalized/completed timestamp. Label and decision availability use the maximum of relevant endpoint confirmation and modeled/observed input receipt for their mode. Opening-event lag is separately declared by a future experiment spec; the close-bar lag is not silently reused for an open.
final_resolutions.calendar: No verified known-at-time exchange calendar is attached. This common interface therefore approves no real-date calendar/availability claim. Fixture tests inject their own explicitly fictional calendar. Any empirical replay spec must separately identify source/hash/time semantics or use an explicitly bar-indexed model-time design without claiming real timestamp availability; point-in-time/special-session claims require supporting data, otherwise abstain. No new calendar download or operating setup in this document phase.
final_resolutions.replicate_ids: Five planned paired replicate IDs,0..4, are recorded as a design choice for a separately budgeted empirical spec; this does not authorize five fits now.
final_resolutions.scope: This freezes input/output semantics only. Proposed next code and fixture-test scope is a separate document requiring peer ownership/scope acknowledgement before implementation. Existing models/data/jobs and project code remain unchanged.
